title: Toy world
notes: Models (studio.model(name), load with GLTFLoader.parse) share ONE texture that is shipped as the image "colormap": after parsing, set every mesh material's map to a THREE.Texture made from studio.image('colormap') (flipY = false, colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace) — see games/*explorer* template. Units are meters on a 1 m grid; models sit on y = 0 and are centered in x/z. Blocks: block_grass (1x1x1), block_grass_low (1x0.5x1), block_grass_long (2x1x1), block_grass_large (2x1x2), block_grass_large_tall (2x2x2), platform (1x0.2x1 thin slab), platform_ramp, block_moving (for moving platforms). Pickups: coin_gold, star, heart, jewel, key, chest. Goal: flag. Hazards: spike_block, trap_spikes, saw. Props: spring, tree, tree_pine, rocks, flowers, mushrooms, grass, plant, fence_straight, crate, sign. Hero: character_oobi (0.9 m tall, faces +z) with animations static, idle, walk, sprint, jump, fall, crouch, sit, drive, die, pick-up, emote-yes. Sounds: jump, coin, gem, hurt, bump, select, magic (win).
